_note: A faked Bugzilla corpus for the duplicate search. The ids and texts are fake; the wording follows real media reports.

bugs.summary: Bluetooth headphone audio fades in after resuming playback in Firefox
comments: When I pause a YouTube video and resume it, the audio starts quiet and fades in over about a second. I use Bluetooth headphones.

bugs.summary: Playing tab stays silent after Bluetooth connects
comments: Connect Bluetooth headphones while a video plays. The tab stays silent until a reload.

bugs.summary: YouTube Audio/Video desync with Bluetooth devices when pausing or skipping
comments: With Bluetooth earbuds the audio lags behind the picture after pausing the video.

bugs.summary: When playing video from any website in a paused state or skipping 5/10 seconds with the arrow keys, the audio would cut out and take a half second to fade back in with the video still playing.
comments: Steps: play any video, pause it, then play again, or skip 5/10 seconds with the arrow keys. The audio cuts out and takes about half a second to fade back in. I use a headset (Example Maxwell in wireless mode). Another browser does not do this.
HDR video looks washed out on an external monitor.

bugs.summary: Audio Distortion when skipping around or unpausing videos (no fade in and out)
comments: Seeking produces a loud click. There is no fade in or fade out on the audio.

bugs.summary: Audio stutters on Windows after sleep
comments: The regressing push is changeset a3fade12bc. Resume from sleep and the audio stutters through the headphones.
Crash reports when playback resumes after a device change.

bugs.summary: Pause button does nothing on a streaming site
comments: Clicking pause does not stop the video.

bugs.summary: Wireless headset crackles in video calls
comments: The microphone of my wireless headset crackles in calls.

bugs.summary: Video freezes after seeking with the keyboard
comments: Seek with the arrow keys and the picture freezes.
Tracking bug for audio problems with Bluetooth headphones and headsets, such as a fade in after a pause.

bugs.summary: Link status panel doesn't fade after clicking a link
comments: The panel does not fade out after a pause of the pointer over a link with headphones on.
